units.source_text: 市场正中的地方生长着一棵法国梧桐树，树枝西面延展。

en.t: A French plane tree grew in the middle of the market, its branches spreading westward.

units.source_text: 他站在树下，透过树枝仰望天空。

en.t: He stood beneath the tree and looked up at the sky through the branches.

units.source_text: 他头顶上空，正好亮着一颗星星。

en.t: Directly above his head, a single star was shining.
